top source red_strflow

SST pipeline

result = red_strflow(txt [, after_line=string] [, before_line=string] [, indents=string or number(s)] [, width=integer])

Split text into multiple lines, not exceeding a specified length. As a function, return the text. As a subroutine, print it.

Return value

The reflowed text as a strarr.

Parameters

txt in type=string or strarr

The text to be reflowed.

Keywords

after_line in optional type=string

Print this as a line after printing txt.

before_line in optional type=string

Print this as a line before printing txt.

indents in optional type=string or number(s)

This string, is added at the beginning of the first line of text. If array, first element indents first line, second element indents all following lines. If number(s), indent by that many blanks.

width in optional type=integer default=min(60,Terminal width-1)

Make the lines no longer than this.
